name: board-extension
description: Live JIRA board and Claude Code agent harness

board.project.description: JIRA project key the board shows.

board.site.description: Atlassian site prefix. Blank uses the twg default site.

board.twgPath.description: Path to the twg binary. Blank auto-resolves per platform.

board.doneWindowDays.description: How far back the Done column reaches, in days.

board.refreshSeconds.description: Auto-refresh interval in seconds. 0 disables polling.

board.repos.markdownDescription: Where an agent runs for each JIRA space, keyed by space key. A space with no entry here is board-only — its tickets can be read, but Plan and Implement are disabled.

board.conversationDir.markdownDescription: Where agent conversations are written, relative to each space repo. One `<TICKET>.json` the panel reloads, and one `<TICKET>.md` you can read.

board.worktreeDir.markdownDescription: Where per-ticket worktrees are created. Blank puts them in a sibling folder next to each repo (`Method-worktrees`), which keeps them out of the working tree.

board.storyModel.markdownDescription: Model that writes the History tab's story of a ticket. One turn, no tools, so a small model is the right choice. Blank uses the session default.

default.tests: (pytest|npm (run )?test|pnpm test|yarn test|vitest|jest|dotnet test|cargo test|go test|mvn test|gradle test|rspec|phpunit)
default.build: (npm run build|pnpm build|yarn build|tsc |cargo build|dotnet build|go build|pyinstaller|electron-builder|vsce package|docker build)

board.sharedCommands.markdownDescription: Shared resources agents must take turns on, as a name and a regular expression matched against every Bash command. A command that matches waits until the resource is free, then holds it until the command ends. Add a key for anything else two agents must not run at once.

scripts.preflight: tsc -p . && node test/preflight.js && node test/markdown.test.js && node test/git.test.js
